title: Senior Python Engineer
summary: Build and own the backend services behind our data platform. You will design APIs used by every other team, keep them fast and boring, and mentor two mid-level engineers.
responsibilities: Design and ship production Python services that other teams depend on.
Own reliability for those services: monitoring, on-call, and post-incident follow-up.
Model and query relational data at a scale where query plans matter.
Review code and mentor two mid-level engineers.
Work with the data science team to take models from notebook to production.
